cover.title: My Story
cover.subtitle: Everything that happened, happened not to you, but for you.

content: I couldn't even imagine that one period, even though it was the shortest of all I had, would change my life for the better.
[photo_1]
Well, I am not good at storytelling, so I will just say everything as it was. Before lyceum, I was a boy whose lifestyle was simple: nothing interesting, no chasing dreams, no hard work, and so on.
But when I started studying in group E3-22 (Third Economic Group of 2022), I changed completely.

There I met lots of people who somehow changed my life. I met people who were always happy, who knew everything, who were just funny, who kept pushing until it was over, who were always right, and so on :) And most importantly, I had some philosophical moments of my life.
In this section, I just want to say a little bit about the people who somehow changed me.
Well, I think that telling you about all 25 group members would be too long and kind of off-topic, so I will talk about some people, both boys and girls.

Boys: Funny members, always making others happy, cheering everyone up, and just having a good time. I don't even know how to describe them; well, they were the main emotions and the engine of our group.

Girls: While the boys were the emotions and the engine of our group, the girls were the ones who created a rollercoaster for those emotions and were the fuel for that engine. It might sound like the boys were more important than the girls, but I can say that is not true. It is just because I am also a boy and spent more time with the boys than the girls...
And specific people: Well, there are only two people that I want to point out: one boy and one girl.

Mukhammad Amin: Well, he is just funny, and he is the reason why I started watching F1... Okay, seriously, he is a person who is just there when you need him. And that's why I pointed him out. He was just there when I was alone (: reminding me that kindness still exists.

One girl (I can't say her name, as I haven't asked for permission :) ): Sooo, about her, the only thing that I can say is that I was scared of her. Listen, I am not scared of darkness, risk, stupid actions, or loneliness, but I was scared of her in one specific way. Her aura was too powerful. The way she defended her ideology made me scared of her... Okay, now, if you are thinking that I am kidding, I am not. She had her aura, I had my aura, and I was scared of losing to her aura's power (just think of it as the battle between Madara and Hashirama). It was a matter of honor. The way she talked, the way she acted—I couldn't lose any aura points, so I was scared, scared of losing to her.
But she was a good rival. Still, I don't know anyone who has as powerful an aura as she did. Maybe she was the reason why I defend my ideology regardless of my losses.
[quote_1]
That is where my transformation journey started: boys with whom I did stupid things and speedran Math, and girls (mostly one of them) who showed me how to defend my ideas.

quotes.quote_1: Don't laugh, it is true, that girl's aura is still too powerful.

content: Ok, so that was the day when I first started to be interested in something not technical. Psychology
[photo_1]

Well, I still think that this science is heavily dependent on time, unlike physics, math and IT, which depend on systems and sizes rather than the present, past and future. I mean that today it is common to have one style of psychological profile because we use phones and technology, while in the past, people had another psychological profile because, let's say, they hunted animals to survive. While physics... Anyway :)
Psychology is still cool, and if I had enough time, I would study it...
Back to that day, that day I first found out about a thing called temperaments.

There are four main temperaments: Sanguine, Phlegmatic, Choleric, Melancholic. And I will write what I understood that day. I will not write what they are, because I am not sure whether I understood correctly, and for learning purposes I insist that you check out more educational sources :)
[photo_2]
Sanguine: the one guy that is talkative, easy-going, optimistic... Like the one who is always in a good mood and acts in a very supportive way

Choleric: this one is like Sanguine, but has one different aspect. He is kinda more responsive in an emotional way. I am not saying that he is more emotional, everyone is emotional, and measuring it is a calculation operation, not an observation... Back to Choleric, I said that he is more responsive to events, I mean that they tend to show that they are against or for your ideas and actions because of their emotions (not because their analysis led them to this). IT IS JUST MY UNDERSTANDING, I KNOW I MIGHT BE WRONG, BUT COME ON, IT IS PSYCHOLOGY
[photo_3]

Phlegmatic: Chill guy. Well, he is one of those who are always calm and stable, who are able to stay normal even under crazy conditions, because he does not want to show his emotions (not because this is strange, but because: why? The problem will not solve itself if you show your emotions...

Melancholic: Last one :) Well, (if you are not against it, I hope, I will use she instead of he to describe this type, because in my life most girls were melancholic (I know that this is a strange reason)), so she is the only type that spends quite a lot of her time thinking about something interesting, more related to philosophy and emotions rather than numbers, statistics and so on. She is quite interesting to talk to, because if she opens up to talk with you, and really talks to you, you will feel that you just need to listen, because there is nothing to argue about, the most you can do is ask...
By the way, they like reading books ¯⁠⁠¯⁠¯\_(⁠ツ⁠)_/⁠¯⁠¯⁠¯
[photo_4]

And, I don't know which is my temperament, the reason is that I cross with all of them... Although there are many more inner temperaments, like a hybrid of melancholic and choleric... Maybe there is one describing me...

content: Breaking rules may be the hardest thing in human life.

Just think of some crazy rule that you know, not a simple one like you can not cross the road if the traffic light is red (any pedestrian does it if there are no cars and he is in a rush), think of something harder

For me at that time there were several rules related to studying: you always need to listen to the teacher, you always need to attend lessons. And for quite a long time I was ok with those rules. But that day I started to understand that these rules are not always true.
Well, don't think that something crazy happened, I just did not attend one lesson and instead of this I went to the park, just for fun, and the weather was really cool, for me.

Look, you just need to understand, that was crazy for me, I was studying for 11 years without breaking any rules, and that action was life changing. Honestly, I am still shocked how brave I was to not attend a lesson :)
[photo_1]
Well, so I went to magic park, quite a good place for a walk in Tashkent at that time. And there everything started. It was winter, and it was snowing, and one crazy thought came into my mind:
"Why is it not snowing like it did 10 years ago?"
The answer is global warming, so I became really curious why we still can not solve global warming...
[photo_2]

Well there were 2 things that are very close to global warming: trees and factories. Trees stop global warming from becoming even more powerful, factories make global warming more powerful (I don't wanna say hotter, cause it sounds strange)
So, as strange as it might sound, because I broke one rule (quite an odd one), I can say I found an aim for my entire life, to try to solve global warming :)
Anyway, I ran out of time, and should have come back home before my parents would find out everything and kill me (yes, breaking rules was a terrible action in my life)
So, I want to say, sometimes you have to break a rule, just to find something new, something better for you. But don't make a hobby out of it, or else it will be bad for you...
[photo_3]
[quote_1]
